title: Phone line agent schedule, week of 7 December 2026

constraints.rationale: Each shift gets exactly the number of agents in its agents_needed column.

provenance.quote: the shifts for the week are in shifts.csv, with the number of agents each shift needs

constraints.rationale: An agent cannot work two shifts that overlap in time (the weekday shifts are staggered and overlap).

provenance.quote: Nobody can work two shifts that run at the same time.

constraints.rationale: Late shifts require the billing skill; the other shifts have no requirement.

provenance.quote: Only agents trained on billing can take a late shift

constraints.rationale: At most five consecutive working days.

provenance.quote: Under no circumstances should anyone work more than five days in a row.

constraints.rationale: Each agent works at most their own weekly maximum from the max_hours column.

provenance.quote: Every agent has a weekly maximum in the max_hours column of agents.csv, and we can never go over it.

constraints.rationale: Preferably at least 12 hours between the end of one shift and the start of the next.

provenance.quote: If possible, leave at least 12 hours between the end of one shift and the start of the next.

constraints.rationale: Each part-time agent should get at least two shifts this week.

provenance.quote: Please also try to give each part-timer at least two shifts.
Jamal has asked for early shifts where possible

constraints.rationale: Leo, who is new, should work the same shifts as Priya so she can coach him.

provenance.quote: Leo is new, so it would really help if he could be on the same shifts as Priya so she can coach him

assumptions.text: The request for at least one Spanish speaker on every weekday shift cannot be expressed in the catalog and is not enforced; it needs a human check.
Weekly hours are counted from the scheduled shift start and end times; breaks are not deducted.
